name: feature-parallel
description: For a feature that touches several areas: a plan splits it into parts, each with surfaces no other part touches and a contract they all keep; the parts are built side by side, each starting as a fork of the plan's session, joined into one branch, and the joined change goes through the review chain of `feature`. A plan of one part is today's `feature`

steps.title: Split it into parts
steps.prompt:
Plan, without changing any file, how to build this feature in parts that run side by side: {goal}

Read the code it touches. Split it only where its areas are really apart: each part gets surfaces no other part reaches, and the contract names what the parts share. A part that builds on another's work names it with `after`, so the work runs in phases. Read the layout and the interfaces the parts share, not every file: each part's worker reads its own code. When splitting does not pay (one area, or parts that would keep touching each other), give one part.

steps.title: Build each part, with its tests
steps.prompt:
Build this feature, or the part of it given below when the plan split it: {goal}

Read the code it touches and decide the approach yourself, then build it with the tests that prove it works: a failing test first, then the code. Run them, and the suite around them, before you stop.

steps.title: Join the parts
steps.prompt:
Join the parts built for this feature into one branch: {goal}

Change only what makes the parts work together, keep the contract, and run the tests before you stop.

steps.title: Review the change
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file, the change made for: {goal}

Read the diff named below: bugs, missing tests, broken behaviour. Report each real problem in `findings`: its place (file:line), what is wrong, how it is known (`deterministic` with the command or hunk that shows it as `proof`, else `inferential`) and whether this change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Decide what the review only read
steps.prompt: Decide, without changing any file, the findings on the change for: {goal}

steps.title: Fix the confirmed findings
steps.prompt:
Fix the confirmed findings below, in the change for: {goal}

Run the tests before you stop.

steps.title: Check each fix
steps.prompt: Check, without changing any file, the fix just made in the change for: {goal}
